candidates.description: This vector represents common Hebrew letters and character fragments used in tokenization.
This feature vector activates on common Spanish words, prefixes, and subword tokens starting with the letters "se" or "sig".
This feature vector represents three-digit numerical values, likely corresponding to area codes, postal codes, or numeric identifiers.
This vector represents closing punctuation marks, often combining quotation marks or parentheses with terminal sentence punctuation.
This vector represents common Spanish verbs, primarily inflected in past and present tenses.
These tokens are relative pronouns and subordinating conjunctions used to introduce dependent clauses and questions in Romance languages.
This feature vector represents active verbs indicating actions, states, or processes.
Latin-derived roots and verb-to-noun morphological affixes involving semantic distinctions or categorizations.
This vector represents concepts of scale, importance, and magnitude across multiple languages.
